painted.label: Painted adventure
painted.prompt: Hand-painted 1990s fantasy RPG spell effect illustration, luminous opaque gouache-like colour modelling with a hot bright core falling to darker saturated edges, broad painted planes and a few fine glowing flecks. Original local colours. Smoothly drawn high resolution shapes, no square pixel clusters.

inked.label: Inked dark fantasy / UI kin
inked.prompt: Inked dark-fantasy illustration with a tight palette: economical dark-brown contour and broken interior ink accents, flat-to-painted natural local colour, rough-edged gouache highlights and controlled hatching in the deepest shadow. The tone should sit beside weathered-stone and brass game UI without turning the object into stone or adding fittings. Strong silhouette, readable middle tones, antique craft rather than polished digital fantasy.

gouache.label: Warm storybook gouache
gouache.prompt: Old illustrated fantasy bestiary and adventure-book gouache, gentle warm/cool colour interplay within the object's original colours, opaque layered brush shapes, softly worn paint and delicate dry-brush edges. A tactile quietly charming handmade object with simple modelling and a few fine descriptive accents. No black comic outline, no paper background, no ornamental manuscript border and no invented decoration.

etched.label: Tinted engraving
etched.prompt: A restrained antique fantasy equipment engraving with fine broken umber contour, short directional crosshatching that wraps the existing volumes, and opaque muted natural-colour washes. Preserve the object's tan or gold local colour rather than turning the image sepia or monochrome. Readable large shapes before line texture; use very little hatching in lit areas, no surrounding page, border or typography.

collection_rules: Make this belong to one coherent set of spell icons in a restrained fantasy palette. Keep the source's colours, silhouette and the arrangement of its bright and dark regions: a swirl, cloud, lattice, flame, crescent or comet of magical energy that fills most of a square. Abstract magical energy only: no hands, wizard, wand, book, creature, rune, letter, symbol, text, border or frame; the shape named in the contract is the only shape.
presentation: One isolated magical energy shape on a perfectly flat solid dark slate grey background, RGB 48,52,59. No floor, no background texture and no cast shadow outside the magical energy shape. The whole magical energy shape visible with breathing room, centred. Longest extent roughly three quarters of a square canvas. Preserve the source view and rotation. Broad soft light from the upper left, restrained highlights and readable shadow planes. Draw actual new fine forms with clean deliberate edges rather than smoothing or retaining square source pixels.
title: Spell icons I2: shapes
task: Task: Redraw a tiny 16 by 16 classic fantasy RPG spell selector icon as a newly illustrated high resolution magical emblem. The source is an abstract shape of coloured magical energy named in the contract: reconstruct a convincing painted version of that energy; do not enlarge or trace the pixel blocks.

items.content: One loose spiral swirl of mauve-pink magical energy filling most of a square, aspect about 1:1: a thick band winding inward from the lower right around to a small curl at the centre, brightest (light pink) along the inner curl and fading to ragged speckles on the outer edge. Preserve the direction of the spiral and the speckled edge. No symbol or text.
items.uncertainty: The source is a 16 by 16 pixel selector icon of abstract magical energy; nothing in it depicts an object, so only the energy shape is reconstructed. The icon is only used as a small selector tile.
items.invention: Resolve soft glowing gradients, a few fine flecks and ragged luminous edges. Keep it abstract energy.
